Quinn Opportunity Partners Llc decreased its stake in Abercrombie & Fitch Co (ANF) by 17.72% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Quinn Opportunity Partners Llc who had been investing in Abercrombie & Fitch Co for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $1.46 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.09% or $0.02 $21.37. About 216,220 shares traded. Abercrombie & Fitch Co. (NYSE:ANF) has declined 47.82% downtrending. It has underperformed by 64.52% the S&P500.
Quinn Opportunity Partners Llc, which manages about $635.47M US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Goldman Sachs Group Inc (NYSE:GS) by 14,000 shares to 15,500 shares, valued at $3.68 million in 2017Q3, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 60,900 shares in the quarter, for a total of 97,500 shares, and has risen its stake in Comcast Corp (NASDAQ:CMCSA).
